list_credentials_table: list all credentials from the LiteLLM proxy server in table format
list_credentials_json: list all credentials from the LiteLLM proxy server in JSON format
create_credential: create a new credential with a name, info JSON, and values JSON on the LiteLLM proxy
delete_credential: delete a credential by name from the LiteLLM proxy server
get_credential: get a credential by name from the LiteLLM proxy server
